model: Recency-weighted Huber return + sample-shrunk calibrated direction; past-only candidate selection

oos.neutral_policy: Predictions within 0.0001% of zero are abstentions and do not count as directional hits

holdout.neutral_policy: Predictions within 0.0001% of zero are abstentions and do not count as directional hits

integrity.overlap_policy: Origins are globally spaced by the horizon; training/calibration boundaries purge immature labels
integrity.holdout: Final 630 bars evaluated sequentially; earlier matured outcomes may enter later fits and calibration. No future labels or evaluation scores tune hyperparameters.
integrity.data_note: Latest Yahoo continuous history, not point-in-time vintages. Missing target windows and roll dependencies excluded. This revised recipe requires prospective confirmation; historical results are research evidence.
integrity.normalization: ATR at each origin scales returns and interval residuals; no target-period volatility is used
integrity.calibration: Non-overlapping completed labels; monthly initial window 1260 bars, extended using sample counts only
integrity.selection: Fixed candidates selected by MAE on first half of pre-test calibration; second half calibrates intervals and probabilities. No future or final-holdout scores select the recipe.
integrity.macro_timing: Macro data displayed separately; this fixed technical recipe does not require incomplete macro histories.
integrity.evaluation_refresh: Prequential refits every 252 hourly / 63 daily bars, including final evaluation; only labels matured before each fit are used. This is rolling evaluation, not an untouched holdout.
integrity.robust_loss: Huber epsilon 1.35, alpha 20; reduces influence of extreme residuals without deleting observations.
integrity.probability_shrinkage: Calibrated probability weight n/(n+100), using only the independent past probability-calibration count; remainder is fit-period class prior.
